displayIdentity.body: Stewards await the Lord’s judgment. So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries. Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.
